subject: TotalEnergies Club EV-Charge public client attribution and Numocity blocker

publisher.value: TotalEnergies Marketing Maroc / Total Maroc SA
publisher.basis: Apple App Store provider metadata and the app privacy/legal page

public_client_conception_realisation.basis: The privacy/legal page linked directly by the Apple App Store credits GM AFRICA for conception et realisation.

latest_public_ios_version_observed.note: Apple describes the release as bug fixes and feature enhancement.

numocity_attribution.decision: Do not model Numocity as app_source, access_network, CPO/operator or status_source solely from prior hypothesis until an independent public technical request shape or vendor attribution is validated.
numocity_attribution.note: The strongest current public client attribution points to TotalEnergies Marketing Maroc as publisher and GM AFRICA as conception/realisation partner. This does not prove that Numocity is absent from the backend stack; it means Numocity remains an unverified implementation hypothesis.

public_operational_signal.basis: Several public App Store reviews in 2026 report OTP/login failures or internal errors.
public_operational_signal.note: User reviews do not establish backend availability or station status and must not be used as a live status source.

modeling.tariff_channel: Club EV-Charge direct only when tariff evidence is exposed by the app/native public client
modeling.status_source: unresolved until a public read-only native request shape is validated

next_validation_targets: Identify a public GET/read-only request shape used by the current Club EV-Charge client for station inventory/status without login or account material.
